prior_art: Two-qutrit W(3,3) commutation, quantum switches and Hesse SIC states are established. The increment is their explicitly certified combined switch/probe/chirality protocol.

SIC_controlled_order_operator_tomography.limitation: The qutrit SIC is established prior art. Any actual interferometer needs coherent reference, calibrated input-independent visibility and a physical gate implementation.

shot_planning.shot_bound_scope: IID +/-1 readout, 99% union guarantee, ideal preparation and visibility=1. Known visibility v<1 inflates the corrected amplitude error by 1/v and shot requirement by 1/v^2; phase/visibility calibration uncertainty excluded.

projective_quadratic_character_extension.finite_field_projective_sign_formula: Legendre(<u,v><v,w><w,u>), with value 0 for any commuting pair
projective_quadratic_character_extension.exact_projective_scaling_invariance: Each point rescaling contributes its square to the triple pairing product.
projective_quadratic_character_extension.GSp_multiplier_rule: M(g u,g v,g w)=Legendre(mu(g)) M(u,v,w) for symplectic multiplier mu(g).
projective_quadratic_character_extension.physical_boundary: A finite-field multiplier character is not a physical parity or chiral fermion index.

failure_controls.experimental_requirement: A physical order-superposition control and per-input visibility/SPAM calibration, not merely a classical choice of order.

physics_boundary: An optical nine-mode qutrit algebra is not physical QCD colour. Chirality phase sign at a projective point requires a lift; a triple product cancels that lift. Physical SU3 gauge holonomy requires a genuinely charged gauge-invariant reference and observable. No emergence of spacetime, gravitational law or particle mass claimed.
